notes.page_content: The sheet introduces the partition Pi_I with a circle/zero exponent, names classes U_s, and writes the relation involving the nonempty intersection of barred U_s and E_i. Its underlined Lemme calls the resulting graph an arbre. The author then writes that a) exactly two U_s meet E_i in the displayed sense and b) i is characterized by the l'ens/l'une reading of those two U_s. The final paragraph writes a signed-component claim using one U_s; the crowded sign after contenu dans retains minus/plus readings. These are attributed manuscript assertions, not proof checks.
notes.authors_own_uncertainty: No explicit verbal qualification such as à vérifier and no manuscript question mark was read on this sheet. The retained question markers are editorial reading qualifications.
notes.title_date_page_counts: Underlined Lemme is the local label. No date, title sheet, or written total page count is present. Archive numeral 23 is recorded only as a comment, with undetermined hand.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: No mathematical inference was used to supply a glyph or repair a formula. Each sign, bar and index came from its own half/crop. No mathematical computation or proof check was performed.
